title: Program / Regional Director
summary: Oversee a portfolio of European construction projects, visiting sites regularly and leading client and site-management relationships.
description: Oversee a portfolio of European construction projects, visiting sites regularly and leading client and site-management relationships.

sections.heading: Main Duties and Responsibilities
items: Provide senior oversight across European sites, meeting schedule, budget and quality targets.
Travel frequently to project locations as senior client and stakeholder contact.
Guide and mentor site management teams and resolve delivery bottlenecks.
Ensure health, safety, environmental and commercial governance.

sections.heading: Qualifications and Experience
items: Experience as Regional Director, Program Director or Senior Operations Manager in construction, MEP or data centres.
Strong commercial and stakeholder management and flexibility to travel.
Unrestricted right to work in EU without sponsorship.

sections.heading: Package & Benefits
items: All work-related travel and accommodation expenses covered, with company expense card.
